create_space_tokenizer: create a SpaceTokenizer instance to normalize whitespace in text strings
encode_with_space_tokenizer: encode a string using SpaceTokenizer to collapse all whitespace into single spaces
decode_with_space_tokenizer: decode a string using SpaceTokenizer which returns the input unchanged
register_space_tokenizer: register the SpaceTokenizer with the fairseq tokenizer registry under the name space
review_space_tokenizer_class: review the SpaceTokenizer class and its encode and decode methods for whitespace normalization
